title: Quantitative homogenization and large-scale regularity for nondivergence-form equations under a critical ellipticity moment
summary: We prove quantitative homogenization estimates for linear elliptic equations in nondivergence form with stationary, symmetric coefficients, finite range of dependence, and a deterministic upper ellipticity bound. No deterministic positive lower bound is imposed. We assume that the reciprocal of the infimum of the smallest eigenvalue on a unit ball has a finite moment of order $d$, together with the common continuity condition of Armstrong and Smart.
